blocks.text: Truth tables mantiqi statements ki truth values dikhate hain. Truth table input truth values ka har mumkin milap likhta aur har milap ka nateeja dikhata hai (Fig 2.5). Truth tables propositional logic mein ahem, computer science aur riyazi mein aam, aur mantiqi expressions ki durusti jaanchne mein madadgar hain.

blocks.caption: Figure 2.5 AND, OR aur NOT ka truth table

blocks.text: Truth table ka bunyadi maqsad dikhana hai ke mantiqi expression kaise bartao karta hai: kab sach aur kab jhoot. Kyunke yeh tamam mumkin inputs likhta hai, is liye uljhan door karta, pecheeda expressions asani se jaanchne aur mukhtalif statements ka muwazna karne deta, aur faisla sazi mein madad deta hai.

items: Un ke liye Sach aur Jhoot ka har milap likhein.
Connectives qadam ba qadam lagayein, aik waqt mein aik column.
Har row ka aakhri nateeja likhein.

blocks.text: P ya Q jaisa har proposition Sach (T) ya Jhoot (F) ho sakta hai. Truth table tamam mumkin milap likhta hai, jo n propositions ke liye 2^n rows hain: do propositions ke liye 4 rows aur teen ke liye 8. Murakkab proposition ki truth value us ke hisson ki qeematon se tay hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: (A AND B) OR (NOT A) ka truth table banayein. Is ko kitni rows chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Do propositions, is liye 2^2 = 4 rows. A=T, B=T: T OR F = T. A=T, B=F: F OR F = F. A=F, B=T: F OR T = T. A=F, B=F: F OR T = T. Expression sirf tab jhoot hai jab A sach aur B jhoot ho.

items: Truth table har input milap aur nateeja likhta.
Column ba column banayein: inputs, phir har connective, phir nateeja.
